description: Amendment 0001: The purpose of this amendment is to incorporate the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) requirements, update various RFP sections, respond to Requests for Information (RFIs), and extend the proposal due date to April 2, 2026. **INDEFINITE DELIVERY INDEFINITE QUANTITY (IDIQ) MULTIPLE AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT (MACC) WOMEN-OWNED SMALL BUSINESS (WOSB) SET-ASIDE FOR NEW CONSTRUCTION, RENOVATION, AND REPAIR OF COMMERCIAL AND NSTITUTIONAL FACILITIES AT VARIOUS GOVERNMENT INSTALLATIONS IN SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA AND ARIZONA WITHIN THE NAVAL FACILITIES ENGINEERING SYSTEMS COMMAND SOUTHWEST (NAVFAC SW) AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY (AOR)
